reason: B offers the more physically plausible, composition-preserving intervention: partial recrystallization can create a heterogeneous refined structure that redistributes tensile strain while limiting strength loss, and matched tensile, compression, and impact tests make it falsifiable. Its proposed 700–800 °C window and 15–20% elongation target remain insufficiently grounded, but A’s assumed ductile Nb-rich grain-boundary phase from only 1–2 at% Nb is particularly unsupported and Nb would more likely remain in BCC solid solution.
